title: Following TCP conversations
hints: Key each conversation by the two endpoints in a fixed order (the smaller first), and inside it keep one record per sender: its ISN, whether it sent FIN or RST, the bytes so far and which offsets are filled.

`s.sequence - (isn + 1)` with both as `std::uint32_t` already handles the wrap: 2³² is added for free when the subtraction goes below zero. Data "before the start" becomes a huge offset, which the 16 MiB limit throws away.
stretch: Add `std::vector<std::string> summary() const` that prints one line per conversation with both endpoints, the bytes sent each way and the state, like Wireshark's Statistics > Conversations window.
